parameters.content:
## Tool: get_book_details

Input: `{ id: number }`

Devuelve detalle completo de un libro del catálogo + sus categorías.

parameters.query:
=SELECT
  cb.id,
  cb.title,
  cb.author,
  cb.description,
  cb.isbn,
  cb.cover_url AS "coverUrl",
  cb.price,
  cb.stock,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT cat.name) FILTER (WHERE cat.name IS NOT NULL) AS categories
FROM catalog_books cb
LEFT JOIN catalog_book_categories cbc ON cbc.catalog_book_id = cb.id
LEFT JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = cbc.category_id
WHERE cb.id = {{ (() => { const r = $input.first().json; const inp = typeof r.input === 'string' ? JSON.parse(r.input) : r; return Number(inp.id); })() }}
GROUP BY cb.id, cb.title, cb.author, cb.description, cb.isbn, cb.cover_url, cb.price, cb.stock;

meta.description: Tool: devuelve detalle completo de un libro del catálogo por ID.
